description: 경기도_수시교통량 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경기도. 수도권 주요도로(고속도로, 일반도로, 국가지원지방도, 지방도, 시군도)의 지점별, 시간대별, 방향 차종을 구분한 교통량 자료입니다. Coverage: 경기도. The portal files it under the publisher 경기도. Its tags are 도로지점별 교통량, 시간대별 교통량, 차종별교통량, 교통량분석, 상하행. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
